picks.title: Suno boss talks streaming fraud: 'AI music is not a crime'
picks.rationale: Suno CEO Mikey Shulman's first direct on-record answer to the AI-music = streaming-fraud charge, as Suno faces label and DSP pressure; new statement, not the 10-22 guest column.
picks.excerpt: Suno CEO Mikey Shulman criticised the 'sleight of hand' of equating streaming fraud with AI music, and said Suno is doing more behind the scenes to tackle fraud than people realise.

picks.title: 50 Cent Trolls Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's Affair With 'P.I.M.P.' Music Video AI Deepfake
picks.rationale: High-profile artist using a generative-video deepfake of a real public figure in a music-video remake; music-only per the 11-15 cross-section assignment.
picks.excerpt: 50 Cent posted an AI deepfake remake of his 'P.I.M.P.' music video starring former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, the latest high-profile artist use of generative video for a music clip.

picks.title: AI 노래가 전화 화면까지 들어온다…민티파이 운영사 뮤직플랫, V 컬러링 서비스 시작
picks.rationale: New distribution channel launch: AI-made songs now supplied to all three Korean carriers' V Coloring call-connect video service — a concrete outlet for AI music creators.
picks.excerpt: AI 음원 유통 서비스 민티파이(뮤직플랫)가 통신 3사의 통화 연결 영상 서비스 V 컬러링·V 프로필에 AI로 만든 노래를 공급하기 시작했다.

picks.title: Can Music Generation Models Tap Along? Evaluating Generative Approaches to Beat Tracking
picks.rationale: New research: an audio-conditioning adapter turns MusicGen into an accompanist that drums along to an input song, doubling as a beat tracker — a distinct paper from the 11-12 MusicFlux card.
picks.excerpt: Researchers add an audio-conditioning adapter to a pretrained MusicGen model so it generates percussion tracks synchronized to an input song, then extract beat positions from them.

picks.title: AI-powered label PaRa Music says it's identified the next big Indian regional music sub-genre
picks.rationale: AI used for A&R: PaRa Music's in-house PaRaMeter platform reads demand data to steer label investment and claims to have spotted the next regional sub-genre — a fresh angle not in the 30-day history.
picks.excerpt: Indian label PaRa Music uses its in-house AI platform PaRaMeter to analyse audience behaviour and demand patterns to guide A&R investment, and now claims it has spotted the next regional sub-genre.
